content_blocks.title: Reference example: Practical Set Applications
content_blocks.code:

SISMEMBER product:tags cache

content_blocks.run_instructions: Set members are unique and unordered; do not depend on SMEMBERS display ordering.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
